answer_1.quote: In this work, we aim to simulate such NL feedback at scale to facilitate the error correction model training.
answer_1.outputs: NL feedback sentences describing errors and corrections in logical forms

answer_2.quote: We conducted two evaluations comparing our evaluator with the existing metrics, BLEU and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: we performed a human evaluation and instructed human participants to rank among feedback generated by different simulators under the same context.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants were instructed to rank feedback generated by different simulators under the same context, and Spearman ranking correlation was calculated between human rankings and metric-based rankings.
